scenario_description:
Objective: Add breathing room before the Kona library coral-model session while the ticketed late-morning arrival still supports the planned setup.
Emerging Need: Early room access becomes useful only if an airline standby window opens for a suitable earlier interisland flight without disturbing the held itinerary.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on joining the bulletin with stored fare-eligibility and confirmation details; the notices alone do not show whether a low-commitment waitlist entry is safe.
Consequence: Timely use would create extra setup time and a calmer transfer; missing the brief window simply leaves the original flight and schedule intact.
